entries.zh: 使受冤屈；犯罪、有過失（愆）
entries.en: to wrong, to aggrieve; to sin, to commit a fault

entries.zh: 乘機（倚仗他人之勢）欺凌、加害
entries.en: to wrong someone by taking the occasion, presuming on another's backing
entries.notes: 西語 fiado en otro 字面為「倚仗他人」，H 欄作「乘機」，義有推移，取四欄合參之便。

entries.en: to wrong someone by seizing a gap or loophole

entries.zh: 暴虐；以凶惡性情壓迫他人
entries.en: to oppress with a cruel disposition; to tyrannize
to treat badly, to oppress; brutal, violent
sour (of taste)
sour and astringent; sour and unripe
steep and rugged, hard to climb or descend
entries.notes: 詞頭 agrio 於此由「酸」引申為「坡路崎嶇難行」，非味覺義。

entries.zh: 陡峭的下坡；崎嶇難下的坡道
entries.en: a steep, rugged descent; hard downhill

entries.zh: 崎嶇難上（如緣壁而行的壞路）
entries.en: so steep that climbing is hard, like walking up a wall; a bad road
entries.notes: M 欄作 iǎ-ó-chiú（疑即「崎惡上」，閩南 oh 為「難」），H 欄改作「難上」，R 欄從 H，義同而用字有別。

entries.en: so steep as to be like a wall
entries.notes: 「成壁」屬記音性的生造組合，M、R 兩欄音寫一致而字面不經見。

entries.en: agriculture, farming
agriculture, or its implements; farm tools
water
entries.notes: M 欄「chuỳ . tug.」末綴 tug. 疑為旁注縮寫，未詳所指。

entries.en: deep water; a deep pool
deep water, deep as the sea

entries.zh: 蓄積、堰塞之水；溝渠積水
entries.en: impounded, dammed-up water; standing water in a channel
entries.notes: 「瀆」本義為溝渠，與西語 represada（堰塞）不盡合，僅據 M/R 對音定字。

entries.zh: 海蜇（水母）；亦或指海上險惡之水
entries.en: jellyfish (Sp. agua mala); also, rough and dangerous sea water
entries.notes: H「蚱」疑為「蜇」之借字（M thê 可對），而西語 agua mala 兼有「海蜇」與「惡水」二義，四欄不足以定奪。

entries.zh: 海蜇、水母（蚱蒲疑即「蜇皮」）
entries.en: jellyfish; probably 蜇皮, jellyfish skin
entries.notes: M thê phôu 近「蜇皮」，H 則從俗寫作「蚱蒲」。

entries.en: jellyfish
entries.notes: R 欄首音作 phō，與 H「蚱」、M thê 牴牾，原件兩欄不一致，所指難定。

entries.en: jellyfish (lit. "jellyfish water")
entries.notes: M thê chuỳ 與 H「蚱水」相合，所指沿上文之海蜇，惟詞形少見。
